data.description: CNT-05 (w2). STACKED on the files-library ticket (organizer reads/replies in its detail surface). One migration: file_comments(id, event_id, owner_type, owner_id, attachment_id NULL, author_person_id, body, created_at). ANCHOR THE THREAD ON THE DELIVERABLE SLOT (owner_type+owner_id), NOT attachment_id — the eval scenario comments on v1, uploads v2, then the organizer replies on the same thread; attachment-anchored threads orphan and the failure reads as data loss. attachment_id is a nullable 'written against v1' tag rendered as a version chip. Author name AND role on every comment. Speaker side in the portal task row; organizer side in the library row expansion. BUILD NO MAIL — the rubric explicitly excuses comment notifications ('SessionBoard itself sends none'). Full spec: section T-F2. Register row 27. DEPENDS ON / STACKED: see boot prompt; parent is the 'Files library and version lists' ticket.
